item: Gate item 47: selftests.json and merge-diag.json sit outside the member deadline, as a stated limit with the profile
summary: Both are long members that do not scale with the corpus; WAL's cold figures sit inside the warm spread (7.2 to 11.4 s and 5.6 to 8.3 s), so they are not a cold cost. selftests.json: 9.64 s of the 12.8 s inside keyword-selftest is simplemma's one-time dictionary load (0.02 s on a second call), so the cost is the lemma cold load, fixed in the keyword lane. merge-diag.json: 6.19 s of 9.19 s is the probe's own synthetic INSERT..SELECT, whose time is the measurement. RC2's figures are plain-store cold-process; WAL's 8.49 s and 7.28 s are the encrypted 9.9 M-row store and are labelled as WAL's.
